info.name: SpendOptix AI Planner
info.description:
Two-step AI planner (suggest -> generate) plus plan persistence (create/save/list/get/approve). Set {{baseUrl}} and {{authToken}} in the collection/environment variables — every route except health checks requires a Bearer token: a real Firebase ID token (project: justbaat-apps), or the static test token already filled in below (doesn't expire).

Typical flow: 1) Suggestions (prompt -> pre-filled form) -> 2) have the user review/edit the "input" it returns -> 3) Generate a plan (plans -> POST) from that input -> 4) Create (plan -> POST) to save it with a server-generated id, or Update if you already have one.

item.name: Suggest form fields from a prompt

request.description: Free text in, a fully pre-filled form out (every field, never blank) plus a provenance tag per field: "stated" (literally in the prompt), "inferred" (worked out from context), or "assumed" (no signal at all, a plausible default). The response's "data.input" is exactly what you'd send to Generate below, after the user reviews/edits it.

Every field is optional (sensible defaults apply) — this is the full PlannerInput shape with everything filled in as an example. Nothing is persisted by this call; it returns a GeneratedPlan (header, keyFigures, flight, bestDates, budgetCurve, cpmCurve, benefitSummary, budgetAllocation, plannedByTeam, audience, buying, brandSafety, checks). Save it afterward with "Create a plan" below if you want to keep it.

"rawPrompt" carries the original free-text brief through from Suggestions (or set it directly if calling Generate without Suggestions first) — it's informational only, never parsed again here.

Allowed enum values:
- campaign.objective: awareness, reach, consideration, video-views, traffic, app-installs, leads, sales
- campaign.kpis[].metric: vcr, ctr (only these two)
- campaign.pacing: even, front-loaded, back-loaded, burst
- audience.geoScope: pan-india, states (no "cities" anymore — states + optional excludeStates only)
- audience.gender: all, male, female
- audience.ageGroups: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55-64, 65+
- inventory.platforms: ctv, ctv-oem, ctv-fast, ctv-ott, mobile-ott, web, mweb, in-app, youtube
- inventory.mediaTypes: display, video
- inventory.qualityTier: premium-only, premium-preferred, any
- inventory.iabCategories: must match one of the real categories in the ingested data (fetched live from the server — ask backend for the current list, e.g. "Beauty & Fitness", "Finance", "News", "Shopping", ...)
- inventory.channelCpmTargets: [{platform, maxCpm}] — per-channel rate asks, e.g. different CPMs for ctv-fast vs ctv-ott
- creative.videoPlacements: instream, outstream, interstitial
- creative.videoDurations: under-10s, under-30s, up-to-60s
- creative.skippability: skippable, non-skippable
- buying.dspChoice: spendoptix-dsp, own-dsp
- buying.spendoptixDspRoute: dv360, authorised-buyer
- buying.dealType: pmp, programmatic-guaranteed, preferred-deal, open-auction, any
- buying.frequencyCap.period: day, week, month, campaign
- plannerSettings.optimiseFor: reach, cost-efficiency, quality, viewability, balanced
- plannerSettings.diversification: concentrated, balanced, broad

Note: brand.url, brand.competitors, audience.cities/affluenceSec/incomeBand/interests/behaviours/lifeStage/languages/audienceNotes, inventory.contentGenres/mustInclude/categoriesToAvoid/brandSafetyExclusions, and creative.videoPositions have all been removed from the form.

item.name: Get a saved plan by id
Create a plan (server generates the id)

request.description: Body is {"input", "plan"} — the exact two objects from Suggestions' "data.input" (as sent to Generate) and Generate's "data" response, unmodified. The server mints a UUID and returns it as "id" (201 Created) — paste that into the {{planId}} collection variable to use the requests below it. This is the only place a new saved record gets created; nothing here trusts a caller-supplied id.
Same body shape as Create, but for a planId you already have (e.g. re-saving after the user edits something). Upsert — creates it if that id doesn't exist yet, replaces it if it does.
